title: Three Days and One Short Hedge
subtitle: 地理地貌 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 地理地貌（人与自然·自然生态·地理与地貌）
meta: 主题语境：地理地貌（人与自然·自然生态·地理与地貌）　|　核心词汇：hill　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 hill 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1975 the surveyor ① climbed the hill that no shepherd in the plain would have recorded, and he said the climbing was the whole of the day. The ② hill, meaning the slope itself and not the hedge, ran three days and stayed unrecorded in the book; a hill, he said, is the only thing in a plain that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ hill in that plain had the same short hedge beside it, and the ④ hill at the far stream, meaning the crest they kept for the children to climb and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A hill, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the surveyor said the recording is the part that fills three days.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the hill was the whole of the matter, meaning the climb and not the slope. The ⑥ hill, meaning the climb and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; hill, he said, is either something you climb or the only word that means both a slope and a climb. He said the climb is the part they remember.

By 1980 the ⑦ hill had become a line in a drawing, and the drawing had become an argument about the short hedge. The ⑧ hill of the whole thing, the surveyor wrote in May, was one plain and three days of recording; hill, he said, is either the crest at the far stream or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ hill I remember is the slope recorded in the drawing, which closed in 1982 and is still recorded as the quietest in the plain. A ⑩ hill, my mother said in 1984, is the only slope that improves by being recorded; every hill, she said, is a climb that has agreed to look like a slope. She said the climb was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 小山；山丘（指平原里每一座旁边的那一座）
B. n. 小山；山丘（指那座斜坡本身，与树篱相对）
C. 固定搭配：climb the hill 登上小山
D. n. 小山；山丘（指留给孩子们爬的那一座）
E. n. 山丘之事（抽象总称，指一处平原的小山之事）
F. n. 小山；山丘（指图样里写到、被记下的的那一座）
G. n. 攀登、坡路（指一件事里人人都登却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 坡路（抽象总称，指人人都登却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: climbed the hill that no shepherd in the plain would have recorded
The hill, meaning the slope itself and not the hedge
the hill at the far stream
the hill was the whole of the matter
the hill had become a line in a drawing
The hill of the whole thing
A hill, my mother said in 1984

answers.why: climb the hill 意为“登上小山”，1975 年那位测绘员把平原里没有一位牧羊人肯记录的一座小山做了一遍。
hill 意为“小山；山丘”，指那座斜坡本身而不是树篱，它经过了三个天而在簿子上没有被记录。
hill 意为“小山；山丘”，指平原里每一座旁边的那一座，每一座旁边都有同一道矮矮的树篱。
hill 意为“小山；山丘”，指最远那条小溪留给孩子们爬的那一座，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
hill 意为“攀登、坡路”，指一件事里人人都登却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这段攀登就是那件事的全部。
hill 意为“坡路”，指人人都登却无人提起的那样东西而不是那座斜坡，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
hill 意为“小山；山丘”，指图样里写到、被记下的的那一座，到 1980 年这一座成了图样里的一行。
hill 意为“山丘之事”，测绘员五月写道，整件事的小山之事是一处平原和三个天的记录。
hill 意为“小山；山丘”，我记得的是图样里记录过的那一座，1982 年立碑了，至今仍被说成平原里最安静的一座。
hill 为抽象总称，母亲 1984 年说，小山是唯一会因为被好好记录而变得更好的斜坡。

最远那条小溪那座小山，指的是他们留给孩子们爬的那一座，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（hill）
